import copy
import json
from solution import merge_layers

def canonical(value):
    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)

def check(base, override, expected):
    before = copy.deepcopy([base, override])
    actual = merge_layers(base, override)
    assert canonical(actual) == canonical(expected), 'merged result differs from requirements'
    assert canonical([base, override]) == canonical(before), 'both inputs must remain deeply unchanged'

check({'service': {'host': 'dev', 'port': 7000}, 'debug': True},
      {'service': {'port': 8000}, 'debug': False},
      {'service': {'host': 'dev', 'port': 8000}, 'debug': False})
check({'limits': {'soft': 6, 'hard': 9}, 'x': 'keep'},
      {'limits': {'soft': None, 'zero': 0}, 'gone': None},
      {'limits': {'hard': 9, 'zero': 0}, 'x': 'keep'})
check({'handler': 'legacy', 'seq': [1, 2]},
      {'handler': {'enabled': False, 'deprecated': None}, 'seq': [3]},
      {'handler': {'enabled': False}, 'seq': [3]})
check({}, {'nested': {'removed': None}}, {'nested': {}})
check({}, {}, {})
print('public checks passed')
